# Oakton College

> Oakton College is an affordable community college near Chicago offering associate degrees, certificates, and STEM programs with flexible online and in-person learning options.

Oakton College serves the Chicago area with two main campuses in Des Plaines and Skokie, Illinois. The college provides comprehensive academic programs, continuing education, and student support services designed to make higher education accessible and affordable.

## Key Topics

- Associate Degrees
- Certificate Programs
- STEM Programs
- Online Learning
- Community College

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Apply to Oakton College | Get Started Here](https://www.oakton.edu/admissions/apply-to-oakton/index.php): Application process for domestic, international, veterans, and DACA students.
- [Apply to Oakton College — Your Path to a Quality, Affordable Education](https://www.oakton.edu/admissions/index.php): Admissions overview with application process, deadlines, and financial aid guidance.
- [Enrollment Center & Services for Students | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/admissions/enrollment/index.php): Enrollment support including applications, financial aid, and academic advising.
- [Visit Oakton | Virtual and On-Campus Tours | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/admissions/visit-oakton.php): Virtual and on-campus tour information for Des Plaines and Skokie campuses.

## Academic Programs

- [Academics | Oakton College | Illinois](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/index.php): Oakton academics overview with degree programs, certificates, and STEM offerings.
- [Academic Programs at Oakton College | Degrees & Certificates](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/program-listing.php): Complete listing of associate degrees and certificates across all program areas.
- [Oakton College | Areas of Interest](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/areas-of-interest/index.php): Eight areas of interest including IT, arts, health, humanities, and manufacturing.
- [Discover STEM Programs | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/stem/index.php): STEM degree programs preparing students for high-demand science and tech careers.
- [Special Programs | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/special-programs/index.php): Special academic programs including honors, global studies, and cannabis management.

## Learning Formats

- [Online Learning at Oakton College — Earn Your Degree Anywhere](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/online-learning/index.php): Online degree and certificate programs with flexible scheduling and support.
- [Continuing Education | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/continuing-education/index.php): Continuing education and workforce development programs at Oakton College.
- [Early College Program | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/special-programs/high-school-dual-credit/index.php): High school dual credit and concurrent enrollment program at Oakton College.

## Student Support Services

- [Oakton College | Academic Services](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/academic-services/index.php): Academic support services including advising, tutoring, and disability accommodations.
- [Library - Research Support and More | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/library/index.php): Oakton College Library services including research support and learning commons.
- [Records & Transcripts | Oakton College](https://www.oakton.edu/academics/academic-services/records/index.php): Transcript ordering, degree verification, and transfer credit evaluation services.
